newsitem.title: UK: Thames Water seeks Indonesian expansion-paper.
newsitem.headline: Thames Water seeks Indonesian expansion-paper.

text.p: Britain's Thames Water is in exclusive negotiations with the Indonesian government to take over half of the water supply of the country's capital Jakarta, the Sunday Telegraph newspaper reported
If the negotiations prove successful, it will be the group's largest overseas expansion to date.
Thames has been talking to the Indonesian government for more than a year and is expected to spend more than two million stg on the bid in 1997, the newspaper reported.
It said the business Thames wants to take over has five million customers, making it almost as large as its operations in London.
